answer: Divergent-Reply Challenge. Each identity must answer a fresh challenge derived from a shared seed, and its reply is kept as a signed relic for later audit. Honest agents answer independently; clones of one controller produce identical replies and are flagged. To pass, an attacker must run genuinely divergent reasoning per identity, paying a separate inference pass and storage of each distinct answer. A botched sonnet of near-identical responses hits a detection zenith fast, forcing per-identity compute that scales linearly with the number of sybils.
